body:
Three entry points, converging on the same `useLibrary` store shape:

```
┌──────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  ┌────────────────────────┐
│ drag / drop  │  │ Open Folder btn │  │ file:// URL navigation │
│  (DropZone)  │  │  (TopBar)       │  │ (content script)       │
└──────┬───────┘  └────────┬────────┘  └───────────┬────────────┘
       │                   │                       │
       ▼                   ▼                       ▼
  readDroppedFile     pickFolder             chrome.storage.session
  + text/uri-list     + FSA handle +         + redirect to
  match               walkDirectory          ?intercept=<key>
       │                   │                       │
       └───────────────────┴───────────────────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                  useLibrary.addFiles()
                  useLibrary.addFolder()
                           │
                           ▼
                      setActive(id)
                           │
                           ▼
            openTabs updated, URL synced,
            Viewer re-renders with new file
```
